expectation: Membrane rings on B cells, packed in lymphoid follicles or aggregates in the gut mucosa and submucosa, with a few scattered single B cells in the lamina propria. Most epithelium and stroma should be negative.
observed: A: a few compact yellow aggregates at the same places in both serial sections, plus scattered dots. B, C: mostly negative; one blob in C. D: densely packed cells with clear membrane rings. E: CD19 has little cellular structure and CD20 is dim there, so E tells nothing.
why: Compact follicle-like aggregates repeat in both sections, and their cells show crisp membrane rings, as expected for B-cell follicles.
notes: CD20 marks a few dense lymphoid aggregates that repeat in both sections, and its cells there have membrane rings. The typical fields are mostly empty, which fits B cells being rare outside follicles. Row E can't confirm it because CD19 shows no structure.
